title: Refresh stale VTC doc comments after the spec revision
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Refresh stale VTC doc comments after the spec revision
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md (VTCParticipant ID Assignment): "VTCParticipant ids are ordinary server-assigned JMAP ids, unique within the call's hosting account"; Leaving a Call: "A room call stays `\"active\"` when it empties"; Recording Consent: "The server SHOULD notify all participants ..." (was MUST).
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/participant.rs:98-100; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:583-590; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/backend.rs:156-171; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/ephemeral.rs:16-22; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/ephemeral.rs:172-174; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs:148-151; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs:576-577; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/backend.rs:196-199
Now: Several doc comments are stale. participant.rs:98 says the server "SHOULD use the userId as the id". end_call's doc suggests ending any call with Completed when the last participant leaves, but room calls must stay active and ringing calls end with cancelled. Other docs quote removed MUST text: mandatory consent signal, MUST empty streamKey, MUST NOT orphaned stream, and "silently ignored" callIds.
Change: Rewrite these doc comments to quote the revised draft text; no behavior change.
Verifier correction: As stated. Also cover event.rs:234 ('a mandatory consent signal'), push.rs:46 (VtcCallPush.account_id 'The account receiving the ring'), and chat-vtc lib.rs ~270-276, whose is_blocked_by_contact doc quotes the old 'MUST check'/'MUST silently drop' text, now SHOULD.

Also (verifier-found):
- Stale VtcCallPush.accountId doc | draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md VTCCallPush `accountId`: "The call's hosting account ({{hosting-account}}). This is usually not the target's personal account." | crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/push.rs:46 | Replace '/// The account receiving the ring.' with the hosting-account wording. The analyst's no-impact entry checked only that the fields exist, not their doc semantics.
- Stale 'mandatory consent signal' doc on the event type | draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md VTCRecordingStateEvent: "This is the consent signal ({{recording-consent}})." (was 'mandatory consent signal') | crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:234 | Update the doc text. Belongs with the doc-refresh impact.
- Stale MUST quotes in chat-vtc blocked-sender doc | draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md Blocked-Sender Suppression: "the server SHOULD check ... the server SHOULD silently drop the ring notification" | crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:270-276 | Update the quoted MUST text to SHOULD, and fix the claim that should_deliver asks 'with the recipient's account', which no longer holds under hosting accounts (see the hosting/recipient impact).
